sections.title: Management Evolution: AMD
content: Phase 1: Baseline multimodal imaging (SD-OCT + Fundus Autofluorescence).
Phase 2: Initiation of newly approved dual-pathway inhibitors.
Phase 3: Extended-interval dosing titration based on sub-RPE fluid volume.
Phase 4: Home-monitoring via AI-integrated microperimetry apps.

sections.title: Key Clinical Pearls
content: OCT-Angiography is now the gold standard for defining non-exudative CNV morphology.
Refractive surgery candidates: Corneal biomechanics metrics (CBI) are more predictive of ectasia than central corneal thickness alone.
Pediatric myopia: Combined low-dose atropine (0.01%) + Ortho-K shows synergistic axial length control, exceeding monotherapy.
In glaucoma, structural progression detection on OCT precedes functional VF loss by an average of 1.4 years.
